name: DriftX
detailed_description:
Get behind the wheel and master the art of drifting in DriftX, an adrenaline-fueled drifting experience designed for both newcomers and seasoned drivers. Tear up the asphalt solo or battle it out online with up to 12 players per lobby. DriftX delivers the perfect blend of realism and arcade accessibility, making drifting intuitive and thrilling for everyone.

Diverse Tracks & Immersive Locations

Experience 8 unique, handcrafted tracks that range from classic mountain passes and touge-style courses to sprawling cityscapes buzzing with live traffic. Each environment has been meticulously designed to challenge your drifting skills and keep your pulse racing!

Iconic Cars & Extensive Customization

Select from 16 highly detailed vehicles spanning American muscle legends, precision-engineered German performance cars, and iconic JDM imports. Make every car uniquely yours with our deep customization system:

  • Performance Upgrades: Fine-tune suspension, camber, engine power, braking systems, and overall handling.

  • Visual Customization: Paint jobs, wheels, detailed decals, vibrant underglow, and eye-catching spoilers, bumpers, and side skirts.

More advanced and detailed upgrades will continually be added, giving you endless ways to express your style and boost your performance.

Multiplayer Drifting Action

Drift solo or jump online to compete against friends and fellow drift enthusiasts in lobbies accommodating up to 12 drivers. Showcase your skills, dominate leaderboards, or simply enjoy tandem drift sessions in a community passionate about the drift culture.

Enhanced Controller Support & Future Plans

DriftX is optimized for Xbox controllers right from launch, providing precision control and tactile feedback. Future updates will introduce comprehensive steering wheel support and potential VR integration, taking immersion to an entirely new level.

Key Features at Launch:

  • 8 unique drifting tracks (from touge to full cities with traffic)

  • 16 iconic vehicles across American Muscle, JDM imports, and German performance cars

  • Deep customization (performance, visuals, decals, and more)

  • Multiplayer drifting lobbies for up to 12 players

  • Full Xbox controller support

Continuous support:

  • Steering Wheel Support

  • Virtual Reality (VR) Integration

  • Continuous updates with new vehicles, tracks, and customization options

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 6th gen i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 10th gen i7 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 GB or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
